title: FBI Arrests Suspect in FBI-Hacking Case
summary: In September, hackers from a group called ShinyHunters announced that they stole a trove of FBI data about its own agents. It was an intelligence disaster . Last week, the FBI arrested (alternate link ) someone associated with that crime.
content:
